title: San Carlos Convent, San Lorenzo

terrainReference.basis: Original source terrain just outside the east church doorway facing the Campo de la Gloria. Local grade remains approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap multipolygon relation 1475937 supplies the complex perimeter and four inner courts. Way 104218383 separately maps the San Lorenzo Mártir church attached to the convent.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap relation 1475937 fixes the convent perimeter and four courtyard openings. Church way 104218383 fixes the attached nave and southwest bell tower footprint. The local model follows the photographed east frontage.

note: The January 2011 Qualla exterior fixes the church’s ochre detailing, three bays, steep bell tower spire and front pediment. The photo documents the building long after its nineteenth-century additions. The whole linked range follows the mapped exterior and all four open courtyards. Secondary elevations, roof divisions, individual cloister bays, and precise heights are proportional estimates. The 128 m source field and local church-entry datum remain unmodified. Local thresholds and grading are approximate. The adjacent battlefield, museum interiors and separately managed structures are outside this model. The model uses original geometry and shared surfaces without reference-photo pixels.
